description: Multiline text field — a real distinct Type, NOT Text plus a display widget. Carries AllowFormatting, the one per-type default the builder writes that the bare API does not require.
notes: AllowFormatting:false is what the builder itself writes on a plain Textarea (rich-text formatting off). Omitting the key entirely is accepted by the API and publishes fine, but diffs away from every UI-built Textarea — write it explicitly for parity.
A Textarea in the 6-unit row grid should usually span the FULL row (End-Start=6): a 2-unit canvas box is the single biggest visual tell of an API-built form vs a hand-built one.
